(Strictly speaking the requirement is "For accurate solutions, the standard CVFD formulation requires that a line drawn between the centers of two connected cells should intersect the shared face at a right angle ... . Furthermore, the intersection point should coincide with an appropriate mean position on the shared face" (

).) Typically, cell centers are placed within the cell. However, sometimes when cells are at the edge of the grid, the cell center might be located on the edge of the grid. An example of such a mesh is included in the MODFLOW 6 examples: ex-gwt-adv-schemes\gwf_voronoi.
